dog.description_text:
This sweet girl is the definition of affectionate. She is playful, curious, and full of puppy energy, but what she really loves most is being close to her person. She’s a true little lap dog who will happily cuddle up, soak up attention, and make you feel like the most important person in the room. Her excitement when she sees you is nonstop — she genuinely lights up around people.

She also does wonderfully with other dogs and enjoys making new friends. She’s a very food-motivated girl (maybe a little too motivated!), so her meals and treats should be monitored to help keep her on a healthy routine.

She’s still working on house training and leash skills, but both have already been introduced and she’s familiar with the process. With consistency, patience, and continued practice, she should continue making great progress.

Honestly, she’s the kind of puppy who is going to make someone incredibly happy. She has such a loving, affectionate personality and a natural desire to connect with her human. Whoever brings this girl home is going to have a very special companion.
dog.name: Upload
